title: Fall Capsule Wardrobe for Kids: 20 Pieces, 625 Outfits
description: A 20-piece fall capsule for kids from Target, one layer, top, bottom and pair of shoes per outfit, with 12 looks to browse and one honest limit per pick.
dek: Five layers, five tops, five bottoms, five pairs of shoes. 625 outfits, twelve to browse.
constraint: 20 core pieces plus 10 finishing picks (socks and hat sets), from Target
hook: A capsule works when every piece goes with every other piece. Pick one layer, one top, one bottom and one pair of shoes from the five in each row. That is 5 x 5 x 5 x 5 = 625 raw combinations. Not all 625 are great, so twelve of them are shown below, built on one shared palette: forest green, camel, rust and navy.

We did not test these. We read each Target listing and use only what it says, so check the size chart, color options and care label on the page before you buy. Prices change, so each pick says to check the current price.
skipped: Anything where the listing does not say what the item is made of.
Pieces that only work in one outfit, since a capsule needs every piece to mix.
Brand-name designer items, since this guide is about everyday prices.
how_picked: Every piece is sold by Target and the link goes to Target's own page.
The listing states the material, fit or cut.
Each pick has one limit worth knowing before you buy.
Specs come from the listing text. Review counts and star ratings are not used here.
how_note: Specs come from each Target listing as read on Nov 1, 2026. Prices are not shown because they change, so check the listing. Product images on this page are AI-generated illustrations, not photos of the items. Listing colors can differ from the art.
final: If you only buy four pieces, buy one from each row in the same palette, then add socks and a hat set later. The formula does the rest.
hero_alt: A rail of five kids outfits in green, mauve, brown, cream and forest with matching boots below
gallery_intro: Each look is one layer, one top, one bottom and one pair of shoes from the picks below. Add socks, a hat and gloves to finish.
